---
title: Figure alt text
format:
  mcanouil-html: default
  mcanouil-revealjs: default
  mcanouil-typst: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A figure with no alt text warns once, and a figure with fig-alt does not.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-html: &warns
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'mcanouil: figure "figure\.svg" has no alt text\. Add fig-alt\.'
          count: 1
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'mcanouil: figure "fig-plain" has no alt text\. Add fig-alt\.'
          count: 1
    mcanouil-revealjs: *warns
    mcanouil-typst:
      # Typst stops a PDF/UA-1 render on an image with no alt text, after the warning.
      shouldError: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'mcanouil: figure "figure\.svg" has no alt text\. Add fig-alt\.'
          count: 1
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'mcanouil: figure "fig-plain" has no alt text\. Add fig-alt\.'
          count: 1
---

![](figure.svg)

![A captioned figure.](figure.svg){#fig-plain}

![A described figure.](figure.svg){#fig-described fig-alt="A grey rectangle."}
